description: Talent and interview score look anti-correlated once you condition on admission.
provenance: synthetic; collider (Berkson) selection on admission (seeded generator)
rationale: Talent and interview are independent until you condition on admission, which both cause. Admission is passed explicitly as a control and is a clear collider, so conditioning on it manufactures the association. Because the selection is declared and identifiable here, the verdict is unsound rather than the usual inconclusive for selection cases.
naive_rationale: an association appears once admission is controlled, reading as a real link
